text: Experts believe that Artificial General Intelligence, or AGI, could change our world completely. Unlike today's AI, which is built for specific tasks, AGI would think and learn like a human. The possible benefits are huge: it could cure diseases and solve climate problems. However, there are serious risks too. Some fear that AGI might be difficult to control or could take jobs away from millions of people. When will it arrive? Nobody knows for sure. Some experts predict it within twenty years, while others think it is much further away. One thing is certain: the future of AI will affect us all.
